clips.title: The story
paras: South of the Scarlet Monastery, Venomweb Vale lies blighted beneath a swarm of venomous spiders. The valley was once a lush woodland where hunters tracked deer and rabbits.

Venomweb Vale has fallen from a peaceful hunting ground to a blighted refuge. Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, local hunters followed deer and rabbits through its grass and trees. Now rot and gloom cover the valley, while giant venomous spiders swarm through the trees and hollows. The monstrous arachnid Sri'skulk leads them. To the north, the Scarlet Crusade holds the neighboring territory. Darkhounds prowl near the fortified Scarlet Encampment, where Lieutenant Sanders commands.
